snippet.title: Truth Scrapper Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…?

Deep within a mysterious sinkhole known as The Dwell, people have been attacked, and have lost all sense of will. Members of the Truth Scrappers guild… just like you!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239830

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
